purpose: Sanitized repository-native pack corpus whose manifest claims disagree with its committed blobs in known ways, so a reproducer that trusts manifests or ignores content-addressed relocation fails observably.

sanitization.content_generation: Deterministic synthetic UTF-8 text keyed on pack and file name; no PO-01 blob is copied, quoted or embedded.
sanitization.shape_mirrored_from: Structural shape only (two manifest dialects, a collapsed shared spine, an aggregate manifest with an absolute build root) observed at immutable commit 1e6f53c323f8326d12af213557082a3665991f19.
sanitization.external_effects: none; the fixture is built in a temporary directory and a local git repository

packs.name: alpha-clean
packs.purpose: Negative control: every claim must verify, so the reproducer cannot pass by reporting defects everywhere.

packs.name: beta-relocated
packs.purpose: Mirrors the real corpus defect: a spine claimed at the pack path whose bytes were published once at a shared path.

packs.name: gamma-absent
packs.purpose: A genuinely lost file, which must not be confused with a relocated one.

packs.name: delta-digest
packs.purpose: Content that does not match its claimed digest, both with and without a byte-length change.

packs.name: epsilon-counts
packs.purpose: Correct files with an understated file_count, so a counting bug is caught independently of content checks.

packs.name: zeta-bytes
packs.purpose: An overstated per-file byte claim plus an inconsistent pack total, which are separate defects.

packs.name: eta-nonportable
packs.purpose: A build-host absolute path embedded in a published claim, and a pack the aggregate manifest omits.
